claim: Source-preserving Charon/Aeneas extraction. Translation and generated external templates do not establish arithmetic, SDK or host refinement.

charon.distribution: Bundled in the hash-pinned Aeneas release archive, including charon-driver and rust-toolchain. Do not substitute the independently published latest Charon release.

lean.library_dependencies: Use the bundled lake-manifest.json revisions and mathlib v4.35.0.

source_boundary.crate: Actual pool/Cargo.toml and production Rust modules; no copied conversions, replacement arithmetic or patched dependencies.
source_boundary.reserve_data: pool/src/pool/reserve.rs:229-252, actual six conversion bodies, plus their real Reserve forwarding methods in the same module.
source_boundary.dispatch: pool/src/math.rs:9-22, actual FixedMath trait and impl for soroban_sdk::Env calling SorobanFixedPoint.
source_boundary.arithmetic: Locked soroban-fixed-point-math 1.5.0, src/i128.rs:24-115 and src/i256.rs:23-51, explicitly transparent via --include=soroban_fixed_point_math.
source_boundary.external_boundary: soroban_sdk is opaque. External templates are refinement obligations, not trusted implementations.
source_boundary.selector_justification: The pinned name matcher needs a one-component wildcard for inherent impls. Exact method suffixes select ReserveData conversions and Reserve wrappers; --start-from requires matches. Inspect generated declarations and source spans.
source_boundary.configuration: --locked --release --lib --no-default-features; no cfg(kani), test, testutils or certora; production release overflow-checks=true retained.

targets.wasm32v1-none: Default, matching production target-family selection. The locked SDK uses Wasm host bindings; those external functions are not proved. MIR extraction with a different compiler is not optimized/deployed Wasm equivalence.
targets.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu: Optional separately recorded attempt with the same normal features. SDK native env-host and its dependency graph still must compile even when opaque to extraction. A successful native attempt is not evidence for the Wasm host boundary.

commands.prerequisites: Python >=3.11, existing rustup launcher, working user-systemd/cgroup-v2 containment, and hash-pinned sandbox tools/compiler. RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 and CHARON_TOOLCHAIN_IS_IN_PATH=1 prevent implicit installation.
commands.bounds: Shared verify_local.py containment and serialization: 4 GiB memory, zero swap, 256 tasks, CPU at most 200%, group cleanup, 600-second deadline; no uncontained fallback.
commands.artifacts: New output directories contain command.log and invocation.json with argv, tool/compiler identities, source/dependency hashes and artifact hashes. Aeneas requires a successful current-source Charon receipt, matching target and immutable LLBC snapshot. Existing paths and stale/conflicting receipts are rejected.
commands.lean_checking: Use the pinned Lean/Aeneas libraries and lake-manifest under containment. Generated external templates remain obligations; do not use sorry, admits, axioms or copied financial implementations to fill them.

stop_policy: Retain command logs, receipts and partial artifacts on failure. Do not replace target bodies, trust generated templates, narrow domains, raise budgets or silently switch tools to manufacture success.
semantic_boundaries: Default sysroot extraction may omit standard-library MIR; missing bodies require checked models or separate extraction.
SDK/I256 primitives, signed rounding, fast/wide dispatch, rejection and representability require explicit refinement.
Drops, allocation, panic/unwind and unsafe behavior relevant to host state require a semantic argument; compiler/translator correctness remains trusted.
Host transaction atomicity, authorization and exact external token effects are not established by extraction.
